title: atoll rules check --json
description: Whether the configuration loads, with its problems and warnings (specs.md §24.3, §24.4, §25). The wording of a message is not part of the contract.

problems.description: Sorted by key in byte order. Empty exactly when valid is true.

key.description: Left out on a syntax error, or when the file cannot be read.

warnings.description: Sorted by key in byte order. Empty when valid is false.

later_phase.description: True for a setting whose feature arrives in a later phase (specs.md §24.4).

hidden.description: The rules an earlier one hides whole, in simple cases, each with the first that does, in the configuration's order (specs.md §11.3, conformance/vectors/rules_check.json). Empty when valid is false.

unreached.description: The labels of the rules no file of the catalog reaches, in the configuration's order; null when the catalog cannot be read, as before atoll init, or when valid is false.
